newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: BASKETBALL-BROLLIES COME INTO THEIR OWN AS COINS RAIN DOWN.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-BROLLIES COME INTO THEIR OWN AS COINS RAIN DOWN.

text.p: Umbrellas came into their own when it rained coins at a basketball match in Manila on Tuesday.

Irate Ginebra San Miguel fans were so displeased to see their team trailing to Alaska Milk in the final minute of their Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) clash that they began hurling sizeable coins from the stands on to the court and the box seats.
But Alaska's supporters had come well prepared, unfurling their umbrellas as soon as the coins began raining down.
The Milkmen won the best-of-seven series 4-1 to score a rare grand slam, sweeping the league's three conferences this year.
